notes.title: MagicShop2 is now fully released!
notes.content:
The time has finally come—I'm excited to officially release MagicShop2! It’s been an incredible journey, and I couldn’t have done it without all the support, feedback, and patience from this amazing community.

Of course, no game is ever truly perfect, so I’ll still be listening to feedback and making improvements where needed. If you run into any issues or have thoughts to share, feel free to reach out!

Thank you all for being part of this journey—now go have fun and enjoy the game!

[h3][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3]
The game is now released, but I’m already working on something new!

[b]Upcoming DLC:[/b] I’m in the process of developing a DLC that will feature a completely different gameplay style and introduce a new type of currency. This currency will allow players to change clothing and hair color, giving even more customization options.

 [img]https://i.imgur.com/w0DFG0M.gif[/img]

[b]Ongoing Support:[/b] I’ll continue fixing bugs, tweaking balance, and improving the game based on your feedback.
[b]
Also:[/b] I will continue adding new clothing.

notes.title: 2025/03/11 Update
notes.content:
-Added Boss 15
-Added 18 Dreams
-Added 9 short story sequences to the "Unlockables" menu
-Added 30 clothing items
-Added new skill: "Frenzy"
-Fixed witch's chest clipping through certain Tops and Costumes
-Fixed Costumes in "Top Off" mode
-Fixed all known gameplay bugs
-Reduced required presses in the Dream minigame from 10 to 5
-Removed monster description before fights
-Big Spiral Labyrinth now only appears at Level 15

notes.title: 2024/10/01 Update
notes.content:
-Added Boss 14
-Added 3 new story sequences, which can be replayed through the Unlockables Book
-Added 9 Dreams
-Added 14 Steam achievements
-Added 54 clothing elements
-Added 3 main screen locations
-Added a new upgrade at the Upgrade Slate - Endurance Exp
-Added 1 new minigame
-Added 2 new traps
-Added Makeup and Makeup Extra categories with a color change option in the wardrobe
-Added a button to remove all witch's accessories in the wardrobe
-Added an option to lock Dreams to exclude them from the slideshow
-Added an option to change enemies' transparency
-The witch will now physically fly in the dungeon instead of a simple wisp
-Fixed a bug with the Shuffle 3 Spheres minigame
-Fixed a bug with the secret Mimic Chest not opening in Memories

notes.title: 2024/05/31 Update
notes.content:
-Added boss 12 and 13
-Added 50 clothing pieces.
-Added 2 minigames.
-From now on, players will need to complete a minigame to unlock Dreams.
-Added an event in which players can buy locked Dreams with Essence or get Essence if they have unlocked all Dreams on the stage.
-Added a "Hide UI" button to the main screen.
-Added tutorials for new and existing minigames.
-Added a tutorial/explanation of the 10th boss mechanic.
-Added a mouse-following wisp (toggleable in settings).
-Added more trap variations.
-Added Vsync option.
-Updated the Gambles UI.
-Damage numbers bug fix.
-Fixed a bug where the witch in the dungeon wouldn't change preset after the Dream.
-Fixed a bug where players could play gambles without having enough Essence.
-Fixed a bug where piercings would get out of place when randomizing in the gallery.
-Fixed a problem when choosing the first Dream in the gallery.

notes.title: 2024/04/02 Update
notes.content:
-Introduced the 3rd biome: Nether Realm.
-Added the 11th Boss: Shade.
-Included 50 new clothing options.
-Implemented 3 new gamble minigames.
-Reduced damage from the Exhaust skill from 10% of the Witch's maximum health to 5%.
-Added a button to remove all main clothing in the wardrobe.

notes.title: 2024/02/09 Update
notes.content:
-Added Boss 10, the final boss of the forest biome.
-Added a Preset panel in the top-left corner of the screen. Players can now switch presets from the home screen or while exploring.
-Added Quick Access panel to the wardrobe UI.
-Added 18 new Dreams.
-Added 2 new Body Modifications: thickness and pubic hair.
-Added Heal Numbers display on screen.
-Added new main screen locations.
-Introduced a new Skill obtainable by defeating boss 9.
-Introduced a new Perk obtainable by defeating boss 10.
-Disabled clothing randomization for dreams during the dungeon phase.
-Enabled texture streaming to reduce VRAM workload during startup.
-Implemented actions to address low-level fatal errors (again).
-Fixed Goblin's skill "Another Round."
-Skills "Change Form" and "Switch Form" will no longer revert to the default preset.
-Reduced damage from the 9th boss.

notes.title: 2024/01/16 Update
notes.content:
-Steam Cloud Saves Integration

-Story Intro Sequence: A new narrative introduction that sets the stage for the game.

-Actions Taken to Address LowLevelFatalError

-Added 9th boss.
-New Dreams
-New Secret Dreams
-30 New Clothing Pieces
-2 New Minigames
-Fixed Clothing Randomization (balanced costume and separate piece sets rotation)

notes.title: 2023/11/30 Update
notes.content:
-8th boss added
-4 new dreams
-14 new clothing pieces
-3 new minigames
-Mini Witch will now accompany you in the dungeon.
-You can only get dreams corresponding to the level, and it no longer prioritizes unlocked dreams.
-"Dildo Dreams" is now only obtainable through brewing (it doesn't matter to you if you've already unlocked them).
-Randomizing clothing in the memory room will not overwrite your own preset.
-Fixed Orc's stun bug.

notes.title: 2023/11/13 Update
notes.content:
Two new bosses introduced.
    A new Damage Reduction stat can be purchased with skill points on the upgrades tablet.
    Skill point regeneration is now an upgradable option on the tablet.
    Fixed the Endurance scaling; Endurance will now level up much faster at higher levels.
    Witches will now receive 100% of damage to experience instead of 50%.
    Added one new minigame.
    Fixed a bug where the game goes dark after the Wyvern Memory event.
    36 new Clothing pieces.
    Three new main screen locations.
    One new skill.
    One new perk.
    Priority will now be given to unopened dreams when opening dreams.
    Five new dreams added.
    Lowered the difficulty of the first five bosses.
    Significantly reduced boss stamina scaling based on the witch's max stamina

notes.title: 2023/10/11 Update
notes.content:
Hey, y'all, this patch doesn't have much content for certain reasons. I'll make it up to you in the next one.

New stuff:
-5th boss fight - Wyvern
-New costume
-New dreams with Wyvern
-Fixed bug with cauldron clothing not opening
-Buying a preset will now automatically save your customization in it

notes.title: 2023/08/28 Update

notes.title: 2023/07/17 Update
notes.content:
-Slightly improved movement in the dungeon.
-Magical Upgrade Tablet - get upgrade points by leveling up your endurance and spend them on various useful upgrades.
-"Brew" system and Herb currency which provide you Costumes and stats.
-Three Costumes.
-Two new dungeon encounters.
-Increased the received Essence for some encounters.
*Belly bulges removed since they weren't working properly.
